text: China reported 27% year-over-year export growth and 36% import growth in June. Export strength was concentrated in semiconductors, rare earths, autos, and ships, while other categories remained comparatively weaker. AI-linked manufacturing and external shipments remained prominent alongside differentiated domestic demand conditions.

meta.note: The report combines aggregate trade data with sector detail; only the contemporaneous trade structure is logged.

text: Warren Buffett directed this year's Berkshire Hathaway share donations to four family-linked foundations and did not allocate shares to the Gates Foundation. Annual charitable share distributions continued under a revised recipient allocation while the stated long-term share disposal plan remained in place.
